ai_summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (ABFRL) has formally announced an upcoming Board Meeting on November 5, 2026, to approve its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Following this approval, the company will host an earnings conference call on November 6, 2026, to discuss the performance, with a standard trading window closure in effect. This document is a routine regulatory disclosure outlining the company's financial reporting timeline and contains no immediate red flags or direct material financial impacts beyond the anticipation of the forthcoming results.
